title: mut.channel_nouf_aljowaysir
mutation_directive: Lumen Prize winner — Nouf Aljowaysir (2023 · Moving Image) — 'Ana Min Wein (Where Am I From?)'. VISUAL SIGNATURE: AI-generated faces of ancestors that morph genealogically — features migrating across generations, the in-between frames more truthful than any single portrait. TECHNICAL HOOKS: A point-cloud face slowly interpolates between latent anchors (great-grandparent → grandparent → self), with particles that lag and re-find their target like memory catching up — geometry: facial point cloud; motion: per-point latent-interp with jitter; palette: sepia, rose, ink. REF: https://lumenprize.org/2023-winners
